title: 50agents vs Make: canvas or plain words | 50agents
description: 50agents vs Make: Make gives you a visual canvas, 3,500+ apps and blueprints; 50agents builds the automation, AI agent or app from plain words.
answer: Pick Make to lay out branching scenarios on a canvas and edit them module by module.
Pick 50agents to say what you need and let Captain build it.
line: Say what you need and Captain builds the scenario for you.
ask: Set up an automation: every new Shopify order is added as a row to my Google Sheet with its items and total
lede: Canvas against plain words, row by row.

strengths.title: Describe it in plain words
strengths.line: Captain asks a few questions, shows a plan, then builds it.

strengths.title: Apps with your own records
strengths.line: Lists, boards and tables, run by a crew of AI agents.

strengths.title: You see every step
strengths.line: Captain shows the plan before it builds, and every step after.

move.title: Export the scenario
move.body: Download its blueprint (.json) to keep as a record.

move.title: Describe it to Captain
move.body: Say what starts it and what lands where, like a new Shopify order to a sheet.

move.title: Compare, then switch off
move.body: Run both on a few orders, then turn the Make scenario off.

faqs.q: Does 50agents have a visual editor like Make?
faqs.a: No. You see every step, but changes go through chat with Captain.
Make connects 3,500+ apps. 50agents works with 2,300+ through viaSocket.
50agents is free to start. Make has a free plan with 1,000 credits a month.
